name: Dr. Lal Path Labs Ltd.
about: Dr. Lal PathLabs Limited operates laboratories for carrying out pathological investigations in India and internationally. The company provides pathological investigations of various branches of bio-chemistry, hematology, histopathology, microbiology, electrophoresis, immuno-chemistry, immunology, virology, cytology, and other pathological and radiological investigations. It also offers phlebotomist training programs. The company was founded in 1949 and is based in Gurugram, India.

verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~28% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~16% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 29% a year while PE moved 71 → 57.
